description: CRIT-105's passThreshold requires the second, post-PROP-21-fix draft (key nfb2ace9f0ed8) evidence screenshot to show '記事タイプ=有料/¥500 in the live DOM'. The actual delivered screenshot at ~/.cloak/note-work/single-price-nfb2ace9f0ed8.png does NOT show this: it is a full-page screenshot of the plain article body (title, paragraphs, embedded figures, 出典 section) with no publish/price panel visible anywhere. This is not a labeling accident -- it is the direct, inevitable result of lib/note-set-single-price.py's own control flow: the script opens the 公開に進む (proceed-to-publish) overlay, selects the 有料 radio and fills the price field (lines 73-116), then explicitly closes that overlay via a キャンセル click (lines 118-125, done deliberately so the body editor underneath becomes interactable for the paid-line insertion), and ONLY THEN takes its single full-page screenshot (lines 165-167) -- after the overlay is already closed. There is no earlier screenshot capturing the panel while the 有料/¥500 state is visibly on-screen. I visually inspected the delivered PNG directly (via image read) and confirmed no such panel is present at any point in the captured page. The SINGLE_PRICE_TYPE/SINGLE_PRICE_VALUE facts are only proven programmatically (via a DOM eval, printed to stdout) -- not visually, as CRIT-105 explicitly requires for the human/verifier (REQ-20) browser review.
